Rumor has it that Apple will use "iPhone Ultra" as the brand name for its upcoming foldable model, with Mark Gurman stating that this is indeed a name widely used internally at the company.

"iPhone Ultra" foldable name reportedly used internally at Apple

Apple is preparing to unveil the much-anticipated foldable iPhone at its September event next month.

Since the first rumors of a foldable iPhone began circulating, the device has generally been referred to as the "iPhone Fold".

However, earlier this year, leakers began claiming that "iPhone Ultra" would be the name of this product.

Although we cannot say this confirms Apple's plans, well-informed tipster Mark Gurman posted today online: "Everyone internally has been calling it Ultra."

"Ultra" is a name commonly used by many Apple employees, but that does not necessarily mean it is the final branding.

Apple is well known for its secrecy, so many employees typically do not know about unannounced products unless they are directly involved in related work.

The internal use of "iPhone Ultra" may simply be because the outside world has been calling this foldable device Ultra. In fact, perhaps only core members of Apple's marketing team and other informed employees actually know the true branding plans for this product.

What do you think — will iPhone Ultra become the name of the foldable? What other names might have a better chance? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments.
